description: Real GBP/JPY reference points for Jan-Jul 2026 collected via web search on 2026-07-23. These are the ONLY externally verified GBP/JPY values obtainable in this sandbox (network egress allowlist blocks all market-data hosts; session web-search budget 200/200 exhausted during collection). They are NOT sufficient for a backtest; they serve as quality-control anchors for validating any full dataset supplied later (see src/data_qc.py).
sources: exchange-rates.org per-day pages (via web search digests)
exchangerates.org.uk 2026 year page (via web search digests)

daily_points.source: exchangerates.org.uk (low, marked 2026 worst) / exchange-rates.org (close); minor source conflict noted
exchangerates.org.uk (marked 2026 best as of mid-July page cache)

aggregates.source: exchangerates.org.uk year page (cached before the mid-July rally)

cross_check: USDJPY closes from the user's own Notion market-data DB imply GBPUSD ~1.326-1.352 when combined with these GBPJPY closes (e.g. 2026-06-30: 215.59/162.58=1.326; 2026-05-12: 213.10/157.58=1.352), a plausible 2026 cable range - the two independent datasets are mutually consistent.
